ModMetaData.name: Fallout 3 Soundtrack - French TradFix
ModMetaData.author: Raptor Ex Seven
ModMetaData.description:
Adds 29 songs from the Fallout 3 music Soundtrack, including 10 battle songs, 5 nighttime songs, 6 daytime songs, and 8 anytime songs.
This mod doesn't include any of the songs from the Fallout radio stations, only the ambient tracks.
All product names, logos, and brands are property of their respective owners. Thanks to Inon Zur for making the songs and thanks to Tynan Sylvester for making Rimworld.
